questions.passage: ① As these English expressions are widely used locally and gain exposure in other countries, they contribute to the expansion and diversification of the English vocabulary. ② Moreover, English dictionaries have incorporated words borrowed from foreign languages. ③ The invention of the printing press by Gutenberg in the 15th century revolutionized the way information was distributed across Europe. ④ Recently, as the Korean wave has spread globally, words related to Korean culture such as kimchi, hanbok, kimbab, and hallyu have been added to English dictionaries. ⑤ More and more Korean words including oppa, noona, mukbang, daebak, and so forth are being added to English dictionaries, resulting in a richer English vocabulary.

→ 미국 영어는 처음부터 표준 영어로 간주되었다.

questions.passage: English has become a widely used "lingua franca" due to its extensive usage and adoption in many countries. As English ability grows in different nations, various English varieties have emerged worldwide, including Singaporean English, Korean English, Indian English, and others. Previously, British English and American English were considered the standard models. However, it is important to note that American English was initially seen as a regional variation rather than a standard form. As a result, we now refer to the different varieties of English as "Englishes," not simply "English."
questions.stem:
다음 글을 읽고, 빈칸에 들어갈 단어를 [보기]에서 골라 쓰시오.

[조건]
• 주어진 단어를 적절한 형태로 변형하여 쓸 것

[보기] diverse / emerge / adopt

As English is ( ) in different nations, various English varieties have ( ) worldwide. We now call these ( ) forms of English "Englishes."

det.korean: 영어가 다양한 국가에서 채택됨에 따라, 다양한 영어 변종이 전 세계적으로 등장했다. 우리는 이러한 다양한 형태의 영어를 '영어들'이라고 부른다.
det.analysis: 원문: As English is adopted in different nations / various English varieties have emerged worldwide / these diverse forms
det.tip: 서술 유형 — 지문을 꼼꼼히 읽고 정답을 찾으세요.

questions.passage: Using English expressions that incorporate the cultures of different countries, we are creating opportunities to broaden our understanding of and respect for other cultures. In this respect, English speakers around the world need to be open to other English speakers. Embracing the diversity of English, we can build a more inclusive community of English speakers where everyone's voice is heard without prejudice or stereotypes.
questions.stem:
다음 우리말과 같은 뜻이 되도록 주어진 단어를 활용하여 빈칸을 완성하시오.

[조건]
• 주어진 단어를 모두 사용하되, 필요시 어형을 변환할 것

"영어의 다양성을 포용함으로써, 우리는 더 포용적인 공동체를 만들 수 있다."

questions.passage: When a language is adopted in a specific region or community, it is natural for it to undergo changes or modifications as the local people utilize the language to more accurately reflect their daily realities and cultural contexts.

It is natural for a language to undergo changes as the local people utilize the language to more (accurate) reflect their daily realities.
